name: territory-hq
description: Territory HQ — Express + Supabase API serving the Vite/React frontend

scripts.build: npm --prefix web install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:portal
scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.js && npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix web test && npm --prefix portal/api test && npm --prefix portal/web test
scripts.verify: npm run test:local && npm run test:postgres && npm run build:all && npm run check:diff
